claim.operational_target: Create and independently verify a signed bundle in which every observed choice is linked to pre-choice context and either a same-person contemporaneous rationale or a verifiable consequence, with immutable evidence roles and recomputable source content.
claim.interpretation: Success supports only decision_context_explanation_linkage_contract_satisfied for the supplied bytes and declared timestamps.
alternatives: public explanation is post-hoc or strategic
shared institution, incentive, or recent state explains later utility
topic or phrase repetition explains later utility
the supplied corpus omits contradictory evidence
any useful signal is domain-specific and non-transferable
claim.scope: Binary or multi-option human decisions with full text context, timezone-aware source timestamps, official or human primary snapshots, and one of seven frozen evidence roles; no automatic training or semantic interpretation.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Offline recomputation checks exact source content, links, attribution, timing, role separation, replay, near-duplicates, schema identity, bundle identity, and signature identity. A future model experiment must separately test incremental predictive utility against shared-dynamic, wrong-person, history-only, and content-only controls on sealed later records.
unidentified_questions: Whether upstream collectors disclosed every relevant source
Whether remote publication timestamps are truthful
Whether a rationale reports the process that caused the decision
Whether the evidence transfers beyond the declared person, task, domain, options, context, and time

evidence.completeness_boundary: Local content and HMAC digests prove only supplied-byte integrity, declared linkage, and declared role allocation. Corpus completeness, independent publication time, authorship truth, and rationale sincerity require an external archive, registry, or human audit.

computation.deployment_kernel: One validate_decision_evidence_bundle admission kernel recomputes source, record, artifact, timing, attribution, role, replay, and signature gates before every load or public use.
computation.selection_kernel: Bundle creation invokes the identical validation kernel before signing; the CLI and round-trip loader invoke it again without a separate formula.
computation.uncertainty_scope: No predictive uncertainty is claimed. Validation covers deterministic supplied-byte and declared-metadata checks only and explicitly excludes source completeness, authorship truth, timestamp truth, sincerity, and causal interpretation.

downstream_consumers: future frozen model experiments only; current fit, update, and semantic paths remain blocked

results.summary: 240 production and decision evidence regression tests passed in 200.991 seconds
